snippet.title: Quarta Amethyst - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
When Olicts, a variety of monsters that prey exclusively on humanoids, begin to surge in the region, Quarta Amethyst, a knight of the Quarta Order sworn to defend the innocent from the Olict menace, is tasked with finding the cause and put a stop to it.
